traits.flowering_position.note: DELTA Dioscoreaceae (read 2026-10-16): inflorescences axillary; APweb (read 2026-10-16): Dioscoreaceae axillary. Dioscoreaceae hold about 650 of the order's roughly 1,000 species; Nartheciaceae and Burmanniaceae overridden.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: DELTA Dioscoreaceae (read 2026-10-16): leaves usually alternate and usually spiral; APweb (read 2026-10-16): Nartheciaceae spiral (often two-ranked). APweb also notes two-ranked leaves in parts of Dioscorea, so medium.

traits.rosette.note: DELTA Dioscoreaceae (read 2026-10-16): twining climbers with leaves along the stems. Rosette families (Nartheciaceae, Burmanniaceae) state their own.

traits.leaf_habit.note: DELTA Dioscoreaceae (read 2026-10-16): tubers giving rise to annual stems (leafy shoots die back). Weighting inferred.

traits.life_span.note: DELTA (read 2026-10-16): Dioscoreaceae perennial from tubers or rhizomes; Burmanniaceae overridden.

traits.hypanthium.note: DELTA Dioscoreaceae (read 2026-10-16): a short perianth tube, no floral cup described. APweb: tepals persist in fruit.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb Dioscoreales page (read 2026-10-16): inferior in Dioscoreaceae, Burmanniaceae, Thismiaceae; half inferior (sometimes superior) in Nartheciaceae.
